title: GitHub gateway foundation
description: Adds the multi-machine Go gateway, isolated patch execution, Airelay agent transport, and GPT Review Planner enforcement.

requirements.summary: Address tasks by gateway and project identity
acceptance: AC-001: Every executable task contains gateway_id, project_id, and task_id.
AC-002: A gateway processes only its own task subtree and configured projects.
AC-003: Project IDs may repeat across different gateway instances.

requirements.summary: Keep all machine-sensitive agent configuration local
acceptance: AC-004: Session key defaults to <project_id>_master.
AC-005: Airelay profile, session key, resume session ID, launch arguments, repository path, and executable are loaded only from local config.
AC-006: Remote tasks cannot submit shell commands or override local agent launch policy.

requirements.summary: Use a file-based Git bus and local task workspace
acceptance: AC-007: Remote tasks use tasks/<gateway>/<project>/<task> and preserve separate GPT-owned and gateway-owned files.
AC-008: Local task files live under ~/.gpt-github-gateway/<gateway>/<project>/tasks/<task>.
AC-009: Symlinks, unsafe relative paths, oversized files, and aggregate task overflow are rejected.

requirements.summary: Apply GPT-authored patch packs without touching the user checkout
acceptance: AC-010: Repository identity and exact base revision are verified before application.
AC-011: Each task uses an isolated Git worktree, agent/ branch, and backup ref.
AC-012: Patch application uses git apply --check followed by git apply --3way.
AC-013: Declared created, modified, and deleted file classes match the actual patch scope.
AC-014: Rollback removes only the task worktree and task branch; no stash or broad git clean is used.

requirements.summary: Route local agent work exclusively through Airelay
acceptance: AC-015: The gateway checks or starts the configured promptable Airelay session.
AC-016: Detailed instructions are written to a local agent-request file.
AC-017: The Airelay prompt is one short instruction pointing to the request file.
AC-018: The agent writes a concise Markdown response and machine JSON result to generated local paths.

requirements.summary: Enforce the pinned GPT Review Planner workflow
acceptance: AC-019: Patch manifests must pin gpt-review-planner v1.2.0 at commit 07ab94b358e8634fa0e547acaa0cf6e237ebbc2e.
AC-020: The local agent is instructed to run gates and make only verified narrow integration repairs.
AC-021: Successful results contain every manifest gate exactly once and preserve the two-commit evidence model.
AC-022: Evidence is verified before a successful result is published.

requirements.summary: Provide a minimal standalone daemon and management CLI
acceptance: AC-023: CLI supports init, project add, projects, once, run, start, stop, status, doctor, tasks, approve, reject, and rollback.
AC-024: The daemon polls the bus and publishes gateway, project, task status, response, and result data.
AC-025: The local HTTP API binds only to loopback and exposes health, readiness, status, projects, tasks, and local task actions.

requirements.summary: Provide deterministic fixtures and native tests
acceptance: AC-026: JSON protocol schemas define task, gateway, and agent-result contracts.
AC-027: Native Go tests cover config defaults, loopback enforcement, path safety, immutable workflow pinning, gate completeness, and canonical fixtures.
AC-028: No third-party Go runtime dependency is introduced.

gpt_static_checks_performed: Inspected the actual initial repository commit and README content.
Authored behavior documentation, protocol schemas, native Go tests, production code, and executable patch payload.
Validated JSON syntax for configuration examples, protocol schemas, and patch manifest.
Parsed and statically type-checked all Go files with go/parser and go/types without building or executing project code.
Validated shell and Python helper syntax without executing project code.
Validated changes.patch path extraction against the declared created/modified/deleted manifest sets.
Validated git apply --check against a repository containing the exact base README content.
Checked the patch and authored tree for unresolved replacement placeholders.
gpt_runtime_checks_not_performed: Airelay session start, status, prompt, and response flow
GitHub bus clone, branch creation, commit, rebase, and push flow
daemon lifecycle and loopback HTTP runtime behavior
known_integration_risks: The current installed Airelay CLI must support start --key, session-status --json, and prompt --text.
The Git identity used by the local machine must be allowed to create or update the configured bus branch.
Cross-platform process supervision, especially Windows process liveness, requires agent runtime validation.
The initial patch is intentionally standard-library-only and may require narrow compile repairs for local Go version or platform API drift.
forbidden_deviations: Do not replace Airelay with direct codex exec or another agent transport.
Do not accept commands, executables, session configuration, repository paths, or environment variables from remote tasks.
Do not modify, switch, stash, reset, or clean the user source checkout.
Do not weaken the immutable gpt-review-planner pin, exact file-scope checks, approval boundary, or evidence requirements.
Do not add third-party Go dependencies without explicit owner approval.
Do not redesign the protocol or broaden the local agent role into repository exploration or principal implementation.
